china.title: Flag of the People's Republic of China

colors.note: Represents the Communist Revolution and Chinese tradition
Represents the Chinese people and golden future

desc: - A red field with five golden stars in the upper hoist corner — one large star surrounded by four smaller ones
- The large star represents the Communist Party leading the four social classes of Chinese society
trivia:
- The large star represents the Communist Party; the four smaller stars represent the four social classes
- The five stars together represent unity of the people under party leadership
- Designed by Zeng Liansong in 1949; the star arrangement was carefully calculated for symbolic balance
